system.description:
You have learned to enter an irregular and erratic fighting style. Attacking with no warning and defending with unconventional motions.

Your Unarmed damage die becomes a d6.

Taijutsu you cast as a Reaction, cannot trigger reactions from hostile creatures.

As a reaction to taking damage from a melee or ranged attack, you can reduce the damage taken by rolling your [Unarmed Damage] twice, taking the higher value and subtracting the result.

Beginning at 5th level, when you use this stances reaction, you also imposes disadvantage on all subsequent attack rolls the triggering creature makes targeting you until the end of the current turn. For each attack they make against you after the first, they also take your [Unarmed Damage] as you retaliate with each strike.

Beginning at 10th level, if you spent your reaction to use this stances reaction ability, at the beginning of the following turn, you gain the special action, Drunken Turn.

Drunken Turn. This special action can only be spent as a reaction to use the Drunken Fist Stances reaction ability. You can gain this special action once, before the end of your next turn.
